title: Animate 2 Motion Studio
kicker: REFERENCE CHARACTER · DIRECT VIDEO MOTION · LOCAL GPU
hero: Direct the performance. Keep the character.
description: Animate 2 exposes two creation modes in one studio and one private Comfy runtime: direct, extractor-free motion transfer with a prompt-directed scene, and source-scene character replacement that retains the original stage, lighting, and camera. Everything remains local and GPU-only; the pose lab exposes the tracking controls used by replacement.
guide: Choose Direct motion when the reference should perform in a newly directed scene. Choose Replace character when the driving video itself must remain the stage. Both use the same queue, assets, output library, and job-scoped runtime; replacement adds a local character matte before its graph runs.
engine: Animate 2 · Direct + Replace · INT8 ConvRot · LightX2V · Kijai ViTPose
runtime_contract: RTX 5090 · local Comfy graph · no CPU model offload
setup_steps: Run `cd ~/multimedia/models && uv run download_models.py animate` to install the allowlisted direct-motion and scene-replacement models.
Run `cd ~/multimedia/animate && ./setupwithuv.sh` once. The command prepares Animate's isolated GPU environment.
Run `./startwithuv.sh` and open the printed loopback URL.
Use Motion transfer for a new prompt-directed scene, Scene-preserving replacement to retain the driving video's stage, and Pose & face lab only for inspection.

modes.title: Character motion transfer
modes.short: Drive one character with the face, body, and hands from a real clip.
modes.description: Direct video conditioning with native distilled INT8 and official LightX2V accelerated profiles, independent identity and choreography weights, optional continuation, the official 21/8 Animate-2 temporal context, GPU activation cache, exact scheduler controls, and production video encoding.
modes.engine: Wan Animate 2 INT8 · selectable distilled or LightX2V
modes.recipe: The reference establishes appearance; the driving clip supplies facial animation, gesture, and body motion. Pose influence can be scheduled across denoising while reference strength remains global.

fields.label: Reference character
fields.hint: Full person and unobstructed hands give the motion branch the most room.

fields.label: Driving performance
fields.hint: The full clip, FPS, and delivery resolution match automatically. Generation runs on the selected inference canvas and delivers at your clip's resolution up to the 2160 ceiling.

options.label: Native distilled INT8
options.description: Verified upstream 10-step Euler path. Fast, compact, and already installed.

options.label: LightX2V · official Comfy
options.description: Base INT8 + rank-64 LoRA using Comfy's published 6-step LCM recipe.

options.label: LightX2V · 4-step speed
options.description: Literal four-step LCM mode for maximum throughput; the official Comfy template currently uses six.

options.label: 480p class · LightX2V reference
options.description: The canvas the LightX2V rank-64 step-distill LoRA was trained on; Kijai's published recipe. Verified headroom.

options.label: 720p class · verified
options.description: 1280x720-equivalent generation canvas. Proven headroom on the 32 GiB GPU; outside the LightX2V LoRA's 480p training range.

options.label: 1080p class · maximum detail
options.description: 1920x1080-equivalent canvas for the sharpest generated detail; the heaviest VRAM path and most experimental on the LightX2V lanes.

fields.label: Character, background, and camera
fields.default: Character appearance description: Preserve the reference character's face, proportions, clothing, and materials. Background description: A coherent cinematic environment with natural lighting. Camera description: Stable medium full-body framing with gentle cinematic camera movement.
fields.hint: Describe appearance, scene, and camera. Put body motion in the choreography field below.

fields.label: Choreography direction
fields.default: The character performs natural body motion with expressive facial animation and coherent hand gestures; the background remains stable.

fields.label: Frames · 4n+1
fields.hint: Upload matching uses the complete source clip and rounds once to 4n+1; no output-video segmentation is introduced.

fields.label: Previous generated clip · optional
fields.drop_label: Continue from an earlier motion clip
fields.hint: Carries the terminal motion frame into the next segment and adjusts the offset.

fields.label: Reference identity
fields.hint: Lower permits restyling; higher resists visual drift.

fields.label: Pose ends
fields.hint: Ending earlier loosens fine detail while preserving early choreography.

fields.label: Continuation cleanup
fields.toggle_label: Trim the duplicated first decoded frame

advanced.label: Manual sampling override
advanced.toggle_label: Override the selected profile's verified sampler recipe

advanced.label: Override steps
advanced.hint: Used only when manual sampling override is enabled.

advanced.label: Override CFG
advanced.hint: Used only when manual sampling override is enabled.

advanced.label: Negative prompt
advanced.default: oversaturated, overexposed, static, blurred details, subtitles, painting, still frame, gray cast, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, ugly, malformed limbs, fused fingers, bad hands, bad face, frozen motion, cluttered background, duplicate limbs, backwards walking

options.label: Disabled · safest
options.description: Keeps maximum headroom; pose work repeats each step.

options.label: INT8

modes.title: Replace character · preserve scene
modes.short: Replace the performer while retaining the source stage, lighting, framing, and camera.
modes.description: The official Wan2.2 Animate Mix path: local ViTPose and face extraction drive the replacement character, the source video supplies the background, and a private BiRefNet pass creates the character mask automatically before Comfy starts.
modes.engine: Animate 2 replacement graph · 14B INT8 ConvRot · LightX2V 4-step
modes.recipe: Use a clean target-character image and the original video whose environment must remain intact. The automatic matte isolates the original performer; the rest of every source frame is conditioned back into the result.

fields.label: Replacement character
fields.hint: A full-body image with visible hands produces the cleanest replacement.

fields.label: Original scene
fields.drop_label: Drop the video whose stage should remain
fields.hint: Resolution, FPS, and the official 77-frame single-pass window match automatically. The 480p LightX2V distill canvas generates the pass; delivery matches your clip up to the 2160 ceiling.

options.label: Automatic local matte
options.description: Run the shared private BiRefNet model frame by frame before loading Wan.

options.label: Prepared mask video
options.description: Use a synchronized white-character-on-black mask video instead.

fields.label: Prepared mask · optional
fields.hint: Used only when Prepared mask video is selected. White replaces; black preserves the source.

fields.label: Replacement description
fields.default: The reference character replaces the performer naturally, matching the original scene's lighting, color, perspective, and contact shadows while preserving the environment and camera movement.

fields.label: Frames · 4n+1
fields.hint: The official Mix graph is one native 77-frame pass; no hidden generation segmentation is introduced.

modes.title: Pose & face diagnostic lab
modes.short: Render the full-body, hand, head, and face tracking proof before a difficult animation.
modes.description: Runs the pinned Kijai CUDA ONNX preprocessor and exports a retargeted ViTPose movie, synchronized 512px face crops, and key-body-point JSON. It is a diagnostic/creative utility; normal Animate 2 generation remains end-to-end.
modes.recipe: Add a retarget image to align proportions to the destination character. Stick widths of -1 are automatic; zero disables that body region.

fields.label: Retarget reference · optional
fields.drop_label: Align the skeleton to another character
